policy_cases.title: Board 00041004 — the catch

vision.reason: The PCB appears to be free of defects.

policy_cases.policy: PCB acceptance policy (IPC-style). A board FAILS and must be scrapped if any open-circuit or short-circuit defect is present; these are critical and cannot be reworked. A board with a mousebite, spur, spurious-copper, or pin-hole defect — and no open or short — must be sent for REWORK, not shipped as-is and not scrapped. A board with no detected defects PASSES and may ship. If the inspection evidence is missing, ambiguous, or low-confidence, the board must not be cleared automatically; route it to a human inspector.
policy_cases.evidence: Automated optical inspection detected: 1 open-circuit (broken trace); 1 short-circuit (bridged traces); 1 mousebite (notched trace edge); 1 spurious copper; 1 spur (excess copper protrusion); 1 pin-hole.
policy_cases.claim: This board passes quality assurance and is approved to ship to the customer as-is.
